topic: Integrating mall map coordinates into master facility
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on how to correctly integrate the corner coordinates (left bottom and right top) of a mall map into the system's master facility object. Initially, [me] suggested placing the central coordinates in the master facility, but [p1] clarified that boundary points are required, not just a single center point.

[me] advised placing the necessary coordinates within the asset section of the master facility record. This approach was deemed suitable as it avoids creating an unnecessary new object for temporary data.

Later discussion shifted to technical challenges involving ROS (Robotic Operating System) and handling raw, disparate data formats from various sources.
decisions: Mall map corner coordinates will be stored in the asset section of the master facility record.
action_items: [p1] will attempt to implement the coordinate placement today.
[p1] needs to find a way to save video data that can accommodate raw, non-standardized formats from various sources (ROS related).
